text:
Maya: heads up — I'm prototyping an 'early observability' pane for staged deploys. goal: surface divergence vs baseline in the first 5% of traffic and show per-route failure/latency breakdowns.
Devon: love it. are you thinking this is a new dashboard or a mode on the existing rollout view?
Maya: probably a mode. minimal UI: top-row summary (delta p95, error rate delta, traffic pct), then a small table of routes with sparkline + trend score.
Priya: important: we need a clear signal for unsafe divergence. propose a score that combines %error increase and p95 regression, with a gating threshold. keeps ops from chasing noise.
Sam: agree. also would be helpful to include the active traffic policy config in the view (e.g., current split, decay window) so SREs can correlate config changes.
Rachel: UX nit — show absolute numbers alongside percentages. small services with tiny baseline traffic will skew percent deltas.
Maya: yep. plan to show both and a 'confidence' band based on sample size. low-sample routes get a flagged badge.
Devon: question about alerts — do we fire alerts from this early pane or only from aggregated canary signals? we don't want alert fatigue from <5% noise.
Priya: keep alerts conservative. maybe two-tier: non-actionable badges for early divergence; only fire an alert when divergence persists beyond X minutes or crosses a confidence threshold.
Sam: +1. propose: badge -> snoozeable signal; alert -> when sustained for 10m AND sample_size > N. also allow manual escalation from the UI.
Maya: quick sketch of the gating logic I'm considering:
```
if sample_pct < 1%: mark low-sample
else score = w1*error_delta + w2*p95_delta
if score > 0.7 and sustained_minutes >= 10 and sample_size > 500: fire_alert()
else show_badge()
```
Devon: can we reuse existing metric calc services? I don't want to add a new aggregator if we can parameterize current canary pipeline.
infra-bot: note: metric-aggregator v2 supports arbitrary rolling windows and early-window sampling. deploys can opt-in with `early_observe:true`.
deploy-bot: staged-deploy-184123 has been routed at 3% to prod (traffic-policy:v2). :rocket:
Rachel: nice. one more ask — include a small inline drilldown link that launches a route-level trace or a quick query to logs for that period.
Maya: yes — drilldown link will prefill log timeframe and route filter. I'll draft a PR for the UI + backend flag. aiming for small incremental rollout behind a feature flag.
Priya: happy to review the gating thresholds. can we add a config map per-team so thresholds aren't global?
Maya: good call. per-team overrides planned.
Sam: I'll add a guard in the traffic-shift controller so the UI can request an automatic scale-back if the alert fires and the override is enabled.
Devon: sounds solid. if you want I can hack on a prototype query and wire it into the existing canary pipeline today.
Maya: that'd be great — assigning to @Devon. I'll open the UX PR with mockups and the config keys.
Rachel: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: staged-deploy-184123 traffic shifted to 5% at 1841234598 (policy: gradual-linear)
Maya: cool — leaving this thread open for short feedback, especially on thresholds and sample-size logic. thanks all!
